goal: Integrate the frozen dual-XGMII HFT baseline with the frozen RMIC M5.4 transactional core without modifying either upstream, while closing TAIFEX futures accounting, execution idempotency, safety-policy, timing, and end-to-end validation gaps.
handoff: I2 functional integration is CI-verified: multi-account futures state, futures order context over the frozen AMU contract, committed R02/R32 trade/cancel/reduce reconciliation, R03 reject release, replay/duplicate fail-closed checks, and the I2 OOC composition compile-smoke all pass. Actual Vivado OOC/post-route evidence is the only remaining I2 gate.
next_action: Run the prepared Vivado 2022.1 I2 OOC implementation with the real pinned RMIC XPM AMU, then review the packaged utilization/timing/DRC/power reports before closing PR #1.

milestones.summary: HFT and RMIC upstreams pinned as read-only submodules at frozen pre-integration baselines.
Order field mapping and fail-closed policy shell established with integration-level reject namespace.
Futures accounting v1 separates long/short and OPEN/CLOSE semantics using a host-configured margin-per-contract research model; not a TAIFEX SPAN claim.
Integration-owned R02/R32 fixed-offset tap captures PositionEffect and before_qty fields missing from the frozen HFT decoder; mutation authority remains external committed-report ownership.
LOB-inspired phase governance adopted: canonical project state, append-only decisions, living ExecPlan, one phase branch/PR, evidence-layer boundaries and mechanical governance CI.

Multi-account/product futures state manager regression passed key isolation, short open, long close, margin reject, fail-closed ownership, config priority and reset-recovery cases. Initial CI timeout was a testbench handshake race and is preserved in the I2 plan.

A 96-bit futures order context keyed by order_id reuses the frozen RMIC AMU contract for account/product/side/PositionEffect/OrdType/TIF/limit-price/remaining-qty ownership without reusing stock-like account accounting.

Committed execution reconciliation regression passes partial fill, stale/duplicate fail-closed, replay-once, fill-plus-terminal-release, cancel, reduce and R03 release-once scenarios with exact order-context lifecycle updates.
Real-AMU I2 OOC Vivado flow, packaging and CI compile-smoke are prepared and passing; actual Vivado routed evidence remains pending local execution.
